d: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has issued a stark warning over the growing use of artificial intelligence in modern warfare, saying machines must never decide who lives or dies on the battlefield. Addressing the UN Security Council, Guterres warned that AI is increasingly influencing military operations, including intelligence gathering and target selection. Calling autonomous killer robots "morally repugnant and politically unacceptable," he urged countries to begin urgent negotiations on a legally binding agreement governing lethal autonomous weapons.
